title: Evaluating Bias In Dutch Word Embeddings

bias_targets.methodology: Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT), Sentence Embeddings Association Test (SEAT), and K-means clustering accuracy to measure cosine similarities and groupings of male/female terms or names against attributes like career, family, math, science, and arts.
Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) measuring cosine similarities between European American vs. African American names and pleasant vs. unpleasant attributes.
Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) measuring cosine similarities between young people's names vs. old people's names and pleasant vs. unpleasant attributes.
Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) measuring cosine similarities between mental disease vs. physical disease terms and temporary vs. permanent attributes.
